Title: Company created from the UI cannot be opened: workspace URL is saved as a slug but looked up as a full URL
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Super admin > Companies > Create Company 2) Workspace URL 'acme' (as the placeholder suggests) 3) Create 4) Open /w/acme/login
Expected Result: Login page of the new company
Actual Result: 'Workspace not found'; DB has workspaceUrl='acme' but the app looks up 'http://host/w/acme'
Suggested Fix: Store and look up the slug only (backend), or build the full URL in the form and show it; validate slug format

Title: Create test fails when optional fields are left empty
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Test Manager > Create Tests 2) Fill every * field 3) Leave 'For Handicapped' and 'Start Buffer Time' empty 4) Next
Actual Result: 400 from API: startBufferTime sent as '' and handicappedDurationMinutes as 0; toast shows a regular expression
Suggested Fix: Omit empty optional fields (or send null); default handicapped to duration; agree rules with backend

Title: Wizard stays on step 1 after 'Test created'; user must click Next again
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Fill step 1 completely 2) Click Next once
Actual Result: Toast 'Test created' but URL becomes step-1?testId=...; second click needed
Suggested Fix: Skip the testId URL-sync effect while navigating (or include testId in the navigate call only); avoid replace navigation racing with goToStep

Title: No token refresh: users are logged out when the 15-minute access token expires
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Log in 2) Wait 15 min (or make token invalid) 3) Click any page
Actual Result: Redirect to login; refresh token stored but never used
Suggested Fix: On 401 call /auth/refresh once (single in-flight promise), retry the request, logout only if refresh fails

Title: 'Maximum update depth exceeded' render loop on the Test Manager page
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open Test Manager while the list is loading
Actual Result: React error 'Maximum update depth exceeded' in console
Suggested Fix: Use a stable empty array constant (const EMPTY: T[] = []) and/or only call onSelectedRowsChange when the selection really changed

Title: Test list downloads every page one by one and caps at 1,000 tests
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Workspace with 1,101 tests 2) Open Test Manager
Expected Result: One request per page shown; all 1,101 tests reachable
Actual Result: 50 sequential GET /tests calls (2.4 s until settled); pager says 'of 1000'
Suggested Fix: Server-side pagination: pass page/limit from the table to the API and use metadata.total

Title: Companies page shows only the first 20 companies
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Platform with 50+ companies 2) Open Companies
Actual Result: Pager '1-20 of 20'; others invisible
Suggested Fix: Server-side pagination like the tests list

Title: Enable/Disable from the row menu erases Address line 2
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Company has address line 2 2) Row menu > Disable
Actual Result: addressLine2 saved as empty string
Suggested Fix: Send only { status } for the toggle (backend supports partial PUT)

Title: Access and refresh tokens are kept in localStorage
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Log in 2) Read localStorage 'auth-store-v3'
Expected Result: Refresh token not readable by JavaScript
Actual Result: 7-day refresh token and access token readable by any script
Suggested Fix: Move refresh token to an httpOnly Secure SameSite cookie; keep access token in memory

Title: Forgot password calls APIs that do not exist
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Login > Forgot password 2) Enter email 3) Send
Actual Result: POST /auth/forgot-password -> 404; message 'Request failed with status code 404'
Suggested Fix: Implement the 3 backend endpoints (send OTP, verify, reset) or hide the link

Title: Dashboard always shows hard-coded mock numbers
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Log in to a workspace with 1,200 candidates and 1,101 tests
Actual Result: 'Total Candidates 842, Total Tests 128' (mock); no API call
Suggested Fix: Add a /dashboard endpoint and remove the forced mock flag; until then label the widget 'Sample data'

Title: API proxy and Netlify redirect send traffic to a hard-coded public IP over plain HTTP
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Read vite.config.ts and netlify.toml / public/_redirects
Actual Result: http://35.154.32.169:3000 - logins and tokens travel unencrypted between Netlify and the server
Suggested Fix: Use an HTTPS domain for the API; read the target from env

Title: Double-clicking Next on step 1 sends two 'create test' requests
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Fill step 1 2) Double-click Next
Actual Result: Two POST /tests: first 201, second 409 (same test code)
File Path (if known): admin_frontend/src/app/test-manager/wizard/page.tsx (Next is disabled only by mutation isPending, which starts after async zod validation)
Suggested Fix: Also disable Next while the form isSubmitting, or guard the submit handler with an in-flight ref

Title: Workspaces page calls a missing API and shows an empty page with no message
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Super admin logs in (lands on Workspaces)
Expected Result: List of workspaces or an error
Actual Result: GET /workspaces -> 404 twice; blank page
Suggested Fix: Use GET /super-admin/companies for this page, and show isError state

Title: Question Bank and Category pages are placeholders; Apply does nothing
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open Question Bank or Test Manager > Category 2) Click Apply
Actual Result: 'table scaffold' text; onSearch is a no-op
Suggested Fix: Build the pages on existing APIs (/subjects, /categories, /questions) or hide them from the menu

Title: Import Tests (QTI) and Quick Assign do not work
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Import Tests > choose file > Import 2) Click Quick Assign
Actual Result: POST /tests/import-qti -> 404; Quick Assign does nothing
Suggested Fix: Hide unfinished actions or implement the backend endpoints

Title: Draft tests are shown as 'Published'
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Create a test as draft (isPublished not sent) 2) Open Test Manager
Actual Result: Status 'Published'
Suggested Fix: Show Draft when isDraft is true; fix backend default (BE bug)

Title: Technical error text is shown to users (regular expressions, 'status code 404')
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Trigger a backend validation error in the wizard 2) Trigger a 404 or network error
Expected Result: Plain message naming the field / 'Cannot reach server'
Actual Result: 'startBufferTime must match /^([01]\d|2[0-3])...$/ regular expression'; 'Request failed with status code 404'; 'Network Error'
Suggested Fix: Map status codes and field names to friendly text; never show raw validator messages

Title: UI and API disagree on test rules
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Handicapped = duration 2) Name 201 chars 3) Code 11 chars 4) Buffer '15 min' 5) Total marks 12.5 6) Grace > total
Actual Result: UI blocks (1) and (5) which API allows; UI allows (2),(3),(4),(6) which API rejects
Related Test ID: FE-TC-046; FE-TC-075; FE-TC-076; FE-TC-077; FE-TC-078; FE-TC-079; FE-TC-080
Suggested Fix: Mirror backend DTO limits in the zod schema (or generate both from one source)

Title: Typed data is lost on refresh or Back/Forward without a warning
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Type name and code on step 1 2) Refresh (or press Back then Forward)
Actual Result: Empty form after refresh; empty form after Back then Forward
Suggested Fix: Persist form values on change (the store already persists) or add beforeunload warning

Title: Topic list is not filtered by the chosen subject
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Step 3 > Add Question 2) Subject = Physics 3) Open Topic
Actual Result: All topics of the company
Suggested Fix: Call /topics?categoryId=&subjectId= (backend supports it) and /subjects?categoryId=

Title: Required difficulty is hidden in collapsed 'Advance Options' without a * marker
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Fill question and options 2) Save Question
Actual Result: Blocked by toast 'Select a difficulty'
Suggested Fix: Move Difficulty next to Question Type and mark it required, or default it

Title: Keyboard and screen reader gaps (see accessibility.csv)
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Tab through login 2) Inspect sidebar and form errors
Expected Result: All controls reachable and named; active page announced
Actual Result: Show-password button skipped (tabIndex -1); no aria-current; see axe results
Suggested Fix: Remove tabIndex=-1, add aria-current, aria-label on icon buttons, link errors with aria-describedby

Title: Layout breaks on phones and tablets: sidebar always open, content squeezed, tables scroll sideways
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open any app page at 360px or 768px
Actual Result: See responsive_cross_browser.csv (sidebar 224px fixed, sideways scroll)
Related Test ID: FE-RESP-009; FE-RESP-013; FE-RESP-017; FE-SIM-007; FE-RESP-001; FE-RESP-002; FE-RESP-010; FE-RESP-014; FE-RESP-018; FE-RESP-021; FE-RESP-022; FE-RESP-025; FE-RESP-026; FE-RESP-029; FE-RESP-030
Suggested Fix: Off-canvas sidebar under md; responsive table (cards) on small screens

Title: Frontend sends X-Workspace-Id / X-Workspace-Slug headers the backend neither uses nor allows
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Read lib/axios.ts 2) Preflight check (BE test sec.cors-workspace-headers)
Actual Result: Every request adds two headers; cross-origin deployments fail CORS
Suggested Fix: Remove the headers (company comes from the token)

Title: Main JS bundle 1.25 MB and CKEditor chunk 1.17 MB
Steps to Reproduce: 1) npx vite build
Actual Result: index 367 KB gzip + ckeditor 303 KB gzip; Vite warns about chunks > 500 KB
Suggested Fix: Lazy-load routes with React.lazy and load CKEditor only on the wizard

Title: npm audit: 2 high (axios prototype pollution, source-map-js DoS)
Steps to Reproduce: 1) npm audit
Actual Result: axios 1.19.0, source-map-js 1.2.1
Suggested Fix: Upgrade axios to 1.20.0+; npm audit fix

Title: No tests in the frontend project
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Read package.json scripts
Actual Result: No test script or test files
Suggested Fix: Adopt qa_tests (Vitest + Playwright) into CI

Title: Empty question save shows one combined message; first-error focus goes to Duration
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Save Question with nothing selected 2) Step 1 Next with empty form
Expected Result: Message under each field; focus on first invalid field (Test Name)
Actual Result: One line 'Select subject, topic and question type'; focus jumps to Duration
Suggested Fix: Field-level errors; setFocus on first error in DOM order

Title: Redirect check accepts other workspaces whose slug starts with the user's slug
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Admin of 'acme' logs in with ?redirect=/w/acme-evil/dashboard
Actual Result: getSafeRedirect returns /w/acme-evil/dashboard (guard then bounces)
Suggested Fix: Compare path segments: redirect === `/w/${slug}` or startsWith(`/w/${slug}/`)

Title: Malformed % encoding in the workspace URL breaks the app (blank page)
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open /w/%E0%A4%A/login
Actual Result: decodeURIComponent throws; blank page
Suggested Fix: Wrap decodeURIComponent in try/catch

Title: Any unknown role is treated as admin
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Backend returns role 'candidate' or 'viewer'
Actual Result: mapRole returns 'admin' with full admin menu
Suggested Fix: Reject unknown roles

Title: Company admin on platform login gets only 'Invalid email or password'
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open /login 2) Enter company admin credentials
Expected Result: Hint to use the workspace URL
Actual Result: Generic invalid credentials
Suggested Fix: Add a short hint under the form: 'Company admin? Use your workspace link'

Title: No Retry on load errors; offline shows stale rows with no message
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Mock GET /tests 500 2) Go offline and search
Actual Result: Error text only; offline search shows old rows silently
Suggested Fix: Add Retry button; show network banner using navigator.onLine / query error

Title: Unknown URLs silently redirect to the dashboard
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open /w/qa-demo/does-not-exist
Actual Result: Redirect to dashboard with no message
Suggested Fix: Add a NotFound route

Title: Frontend .env is committed and not git-ignored
Steps to Reproduce: 1) git ls-files admin_frontend/.env 2) Read .gitignore
Actual Result: .env committed (only non-secret values today)
Suggested Fix: Add .env to .gitignore; keep .env.example

Title: Mock users, passwords and OTP are shipped in the production bundle
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Read features/auth/api/login.ts and forgot-password.ts
Actual Result: admin@testtakers.com / Admin@123 and OTP 123456 in source used when VITE_USE_MOCK_API=true
Suggested Fix: Move mocks to MSW handlers under src/mocks loaded only in dev

Title: Prettier check fails in 31 files; 10 lint warnings
Steps to Reproduce: 1) npm run format:check 2) npm run lint
Actual Result: 31 files need formatting; 8 react-refresh and 2 exhaustive-deps warnings
Suggested Fix: Run prettier --write; fix hook deps
